product_overview: Raya Blue Key 2026 is an Arabic RTL single-page business management system for operating core company workflows from one browser interface. It centralizes authentication, inventory, sales, accounting, service, payroll, and administration with real-time sync across open clients.
core_goals: Provide a single entry point to the Raya Blue operational system using the USB key file as the launch credential
Authenticate users and restrict access by role and per-module permissions
Manage business data for customers, suppliers, inventory, sales, installments, accounting, maintenance, payroll, and users
Support real-time multi-tab synchronization when data changes
Allow administrators to maintain the system through a browser-based Arabic RTL interface

features.name: USB Key Activation
features.description: The system requires the Raya Blue key file to be available at the root of a USB flash drive as the operating key for launching the application.
user_flows: User opens the app with the key file present on the USB root -> System detects the key file and allows access to the application shell -> User reaches the login screen -> System continues to authentication
User opens the app without the required key file -> System blocks access or shows a key-missing message -> No application data is loaded -> User cannot proceed until the key file is restored

features.name: Login / Authentication
features.description: Users sign in with username and password, and the system loads the authenticated user profile and permissions for authorized modules.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid username and password -> Receive 200 with ok true and user object -> User session is stored client-side -> User is granted access to permitted modules
POST /api/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with ok false and error message -> User remains unauthenticated -> Protected data is not loaded
POST /api/logout with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with ok true -> Client session is cleared -> User is returned to the login state

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Users view a unified operational dashboard with business statistics and summaries across revenue, inventory, maintenance, and payroll.
user_flows: GET /api/data with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with journal, customers, suppliers, invItems, wfOrders, maint, payroll, serials, instDb, and usersDb -> Dashboard renders summary cards and charts -> User reviews overall business status
GET /api/data without valid authentication -> Receive an authorization failure or blocked request -> Dashboard data is not displayed -> User must authenticate before viewing metrics

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Users create, update, and delete inventory items with pricing, costing, minimum quantity, serial tracking, and cost method fields.
user_flows: GET /api/data with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with invItems included -> User edits inventory records in the UI -> POST /api/save with invItems payload -> Receive 200 with ok true and inventory changes are persisted
POST /api/save with malformed or invalid invItems data -> Receive 400 validation error -> Inventory changes are rejected -> Existing inventory data remains unchanged

features.name: Serial Number Tracking
features.description: Users track serialized stock items by serial number, purchase order reference, sale invoice reference, and operational status.
user_flows: POST /api/save with serials payload containing valid serial records -> Receive 200 with ok true -> Serial records are stored or updated -> Serialized inventory status becomes available for tracking
POST /api/save with invalid serials payload -> Receive error response or failed validation -> Serial records are not saved -> User corrects the data before retrying

features.name: Sales / Workflow Orders
features.description: Users create and manage sales or workflow orders with customer selection, line items, payment method, and stage progression.
user_flows: POST /api/save with wfOrders payload containing a valid order -> Receive 200 with ok true -> Order is persisted with its stage and payment details -> Sales workflow is updated
POST /api/save with incomplete or invalid wfOrders payload -> Receive error response -> Order is not saved -> User must fix missing customer, items, or payment information

features.name: Installments Management
features.description: Users manage customer installment plans, including down payment, number of installments, and payment tracking over time.
user_flows: POST /api/save with instDb payload containing valid installment plans -> Receive 200 with ok true -> Installment records are saved -> User can track payment progress
POST /api/save with invalid instDb payload -> Receive error response -> Installment plan is rejected -> No payment schedule is created

features.name: Customer Management
features.description: Users create and maintain customer records including code, name, account code, phone, city, and debt balance.
user_flows: POST /api/save with customers payload containing valid customer records -> Receive 200 with ok true -> Customer master data is stored -> Customer lists and linked workflows can use the updated records
POST /api/save with invalid customers payload -> Receive error response -> Customer updates are rejected -> User must correct missing or invalid fields

features.name: Supplier Management
features.description: Users create and maintain supplier records including code, name, account code, phone, city, and balance.
user_flows: POST /api/save with suppliers payload containing valid supplier records -> Receive 200 with ok true -> Supplier master data is stored -> Purchasing and accounting flows can reference the updated suppliers
POST /api/save with invalid suppliers payload -> Receive error response -> Supplier updates are rejected -> User must fix missing account or identity fields

features.name: Accounting / Journal Entries
features.description: Users record double-entry journal transactions with debit and credit lines, account tree structure, and customer or supplier linkage for ledger reporting.
user_flows: POST /api/save with journal payload containing balanced journal entries -> Receive 200 with ok true -> Journal entries are saved -> Ledger and balance sheet reports can be generated from the stored data
POST /api/save with journal payload containing unbalanced or invalid entries -> Receive error response -> Journal entries are rejected -> Accounting totals remain unchanged

features.name: Maintenance Management
features.description: Users track repair and maintenance requests with customer, serial number, description, status, cost, and notes.
user_flows: POST /api/save with maint payload containing a valid maintenance request -> Receive 200 with ok true -> Maintenance record is saved -> User can monitor the request from pending to completed
POST /api/save with invalid maint payload -> Receive error response -> Maintenance request is not stored -> User must correct customer, serial, or status data

features.name: Payroll
features.description: Users manage monthly payroll records with employee details, salary, additions, deductions, and net pay.
user_flows: POST /api/save with payroll payload containing valid payroll records -> Receive 200 with ok true -> Payroll entries are saved -> Net pay and monthly records are available for review
POST /api/save with invalid payroll payload -> Receive error response -> Payroll records are rejected -> No payroll changes are applied

features.name: User & Permissions Management
features.description: Administrators manage application users and assign per-module permissions for view, create, edit, and delete access.
user_flows: POST /api/save with usersDb payload containing valid users and permission assignments -> Receive 200 with ok true -> User accounts and access rights are saved -> Authorized users can access their assigned modules
POST /api/save with invalid usersDb payload -> Receive error response -> User and permission updates are rejected -> Access control remains unchanged

features.name: Real-Time Sync (SSE)
features.description: Connected clients receive live notifications when data changes so multiple open tabs stay synchronized.
user_flows: GET /api/events to open an SSE connection -> Receive 200 text/event-stream -> Another client saves changes through POST /api/save -> Connected client receives a server event and refreshes displayed data
GET /api/events when the connection is interrupted -> Client stops receiving events -> Live sync is lost until reconnect -> User reconnects to resume updates

known_limitations.issue: No server-side session tokens — authentication state stored client-side in sessionStorage
known_limitations.impact: Session can be manually manipulated; no true server-side auth enforcement

known_limitations.issue: Bulk save replaces entire table via delete+upsert — concurrent writes may lose data
known_limitations.impact: Race condition risk under concurrent multi-user saves

known_limitations.issue: PostgreSQL password stored in plaintext in server.js
known_limitations.impact: Credential exposure if source is shared
